period_note: SOLO/SEPARATE basis ('Balance Sheet (Unaudited)'/'Profit & Loss Account (Unaudited)' headed 'Eastern Bank Limited' only). Per project-wide convention, this Half-Yearly (Jan-Jun) filing is the Q2 data point. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2018 (column header '01 January 2018 to 30 June 2018'); this EPS line is not marked '(restated)' in this vintage. Unlike 2019-2026, paid-up capital did NOT change this quarter (7,379,995,890 unchanged from 2018_Q1.json / 31-Dec-2017) — no bonus share issue occurred in Q2 2018; the Q2-bonus-issue seasonal pattern documented from 2019_Q2.json onward does not extend back to this year. Cross-checked the 31-Dec-2017 Solo comparative column against bank_financials/EBL/quarterly/2017_Q4.json: total_equity, gross_loans, total_deposits, investments_securities, fixed_assets, borrowings and paid_up_capital all match; total_assets (253,365,303,480 vs 253,068m) and total_liabilities (231,779,737,880 vs 231,482m) again show the same small ~0.12% gap already noted in 2018_Q1.json — not re-investigated further here, not edited.
